supported_statement: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0), 21 omitted faces per anchor entering as -(tau/3)W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; both signs |tau|<=10^-8, the -tau value a replay of the same |tau| formula; cover R={0,e_z} of the original xz Wilson loop, 48 links, 36 endpoints; observables A in B(H_R); common clock theta=alpha t/hbar with the window |theta|<=8, i.e. U=1 in the internal normalized time u=theta/8), with the two named construction families F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N at least 2, with the Lieb-Robinson bound of Nachtergaele-Sims arXiv:1410.8174v1 Theorem 3.1, eqs. (51)-(52), quoted from the committed excerpt (PDF sha256 501af040512f2bdb62344ecbd093664e79ad1861338eabbce2c9791fca4e2fba), the unbounded on-site Casimirs h_b in the on-site slot of (44) and handled by the interaction picture, and the AQ1 constants F(r)=(1+r)^-4 on the coarse l1 metric, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau| for the whole-star interaction Phi (J=28|tau|, four incident stars) and ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau| for the owner-set interaction Phi' (49 faces per site), substituted as upper bounds by monotonicity: (1) H^{F2,pad}_N minus H^{F1}_N is the sum of the 28N(5N+1) extra faces (enumerated on Lambda_2 to Lambda_5; per anchor 17, 13 and 5 faces when exactly one coordinate equals N, 10, 3 and 1 when two do, none at the corner), each charged once with norm |tau|/3, every owner on the outer layer at coarse l1 distance at least N-1 from e_z and at least N from 0 (both attained), plus the padding on-site terms, which factor out of the evolution exactly and are never charged. (2) Define b(N) = K_cmp (5N+1) N^-3 with K_cmp = 3969/155720800000000 (about 2.54879e-11; forward route: Duhamel with the inner F1 evolution, whole-star Phi, tier polynomial_lieb_robinson, route duhamel_inner_f1; margin about 2.354 against the frozen 6x10^-11). For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8 and every A in B(H_R) with ||A||<=1 on the fixed cover R, the finite-box Heisenberg evolutions T^{F1,N}_theta and T^{F2,N}_theta of the named construction families F1 and F2 on the same centered coarse cube Lambda_N satisfy ||T^{F2,N}_theta(A)-T^{F1,N}_theta(A)|| <= b(N) for |theta|<=8 in the common clock theta=alpha t/hbar; this is an algebraic comparison of the dynamics of the named constructions on a compact time window at a rate in N, not equality of GNS dynamics or of correlation functions of different states, not a uniform-in-time statement, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a. The reverse route (Duhamel with the inner F2 evolution, owner-set Phi', route duhamel_inner_f2) proves the same inequality with the smaller labelled second-route constant K'_cmp = 452554889222515527/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 1.48469e-11, margin about 4.041); both constants are quadratic in tau (the first order vanishes because no extra face meets R), with exact tau/100 ratios 1953058850/194651 and 38176688920663121234473000000/3810205403940325763421973 inside the preregistered bracket [9500,10500]. (3) For F = F1 and F = F2, sup over M greater than N of ||T^{F,M}_theta(A)-T^{F,N}_theta(A)|| <= K_F/(N-1) ||A|| for |theta|<=8 and N at least 2, at the polynomial rate in N at fixed spacing: F1 with K_F1 = 9261/155720800000000 (about 5.94718e-11, forward, faces charged once, inner F1) and the second route 12128856933354903/118967041015625000000000000 (about 1.01951e-10, reverse, whole stars, inner F1 on Lambda_M); F2 with K_F2 = 117747/1245766400000000 (about 9.45177e-11, forward, one F1-inner Duhamel plus the comparison) and the second route 1055961408185869563/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 3.46428e-11, reverse, owner-set Phi', faces charged once); every value is at most the frozen 2.5x10^-10 (margins about 4.204, 2.452, 2.645 and 7.217); a bound for N to N+1 alone is not used as a Cauchy estimate. (4) Hence the F1 and F2 finite-box evolutions of every A in B(H_R) converge as whole sequences in norm, uniformly for |theta|<=8, and the F2 limit dynamics equals the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta: ||T^{F2,N}_theta(A)-T_theta(A)|| <= min(K_F1, second-route K_F2)/(N-1) ||A||, and on every local algebra the same Duhamel sum with R replaced by a finite region tends to zero on every compact window, so the two automorphism groups agree on the quasi-local algebra. (5) AQ1 sections 4-5 are rerun for every subsequential F2 limit state with F2's own diagonal extraction (AY1): stationarity under T_theta, strong continuity of the GNS evolution and a nonnegative generator, with the physical cyclic space reducing it. Not admitted: equality of GNS dynamics or of correlation functions of different states, a common limit state or convergence of states, uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state, translation invariance, any uniform-in-time statement, exponential decay in N with the polynomial Lieb-Robinson function, any rate or estimate in the lattice spacing a, a continuum or weak-coupling statement, and scientific priority.
